verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a public Uptime API with token-based auth (global and team-scoped tokens, Bearer header) in its docs, showing a genuine documented API surface for programmatic control. However, probes found no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec and no llms.txt, and evidence doesn't show broader API coverage beyond Uptime resources (e.g., logs/incidents API details). Missing for 10: machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), broader documented endpoint coverage across all product areas, and independent corroboration of API completeness.
